title: Error 1001: DNS resolution error
detail: Cloudflare is unable to resolve the requested domain. The DNS records are missing, not yet propagated, or the origin DNS is refusing queries.
what_you_should_do: **Do not retry.** The site owner must check DNS configuration. If the site was recently added to Cloudflare, allow a few minutes for propagation before requesting the owner to investigate.
footer: This error was generated by Cloudflare on behalf of the website owner.
